official: 東京都指定障害児通所支援の事業等の人員、設備及び運営の基準に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 障害児通所支援に性暴力防止策を追加
summary: 都は、障害児の通所支援事業の人員や運営などの基準を条例で定めています。この議案では、指定児童発達支援事業者に、児童対象性暴力等の防止と、被害を受けた障害児の保護に必要な措置を義務づけます。主な改正は2026年12月25日からで、用語の変更など一部は公布の日からです。
changes: 指定児童発達支援事業者に性暴力等の防止と障害児の保護に必要な措置を義務づける
対象となる従事者の犯罪事実確認を必要な措置に含める
「指導訓練室」を「発達支援室」に改める
「指導訓練」を「発達支援」に改める
who: 指定児童発達支援事業者
指定児童発達支援を受ける障害児
支配性・継続性・閉鎖性のある環境で障害児と接する従事者
why: 児童福祉法などの改正に合わせ、児童対象性暴力等の防止に関する規定を設け、条文を整えるためと、都は説明しています。

issues.quote: 指定児童発達支援事業者に性暴力等の防止と障害児の保護に必要な措置を義務づける
issues.note: 原文は第五十七条に第四十四条を加えるなど、他の規定にも性暴力防止措置を適用するための改正を含みます。事業者に直接関わる適用範囲の変更が抜けていないか確認が必要です。

en.name: Adds sexual violence prevention measures to day support for children with disabilities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Standards for Staffing, Facilities, and Operations of Tokyo-Designated Day Support Services for Children with Disabilities
en.summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government sets standards by ordinance for staffing and operations, among other things, at support services that children with disabilities attend. This bill requires designated child development support providers to take necessary measures to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts, and to protect children with disabilities who have been victimized. The main amendments take effect on December 25, 2026. Some changes, such as changes to terminology, take effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Require designated child development support providers to take necessary measures to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts, and to protect children with disabilities
Include criminal record checks for applicable workers among the necessary measures
Change “instruction and training room” to “developmental support room”
who: Children with disabilities who receive designated child development support
Workers who interact with children with disabilities in settings characterized by power imbalance, ongoing contact, and isolation
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says the changes are being made to establish provisions to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts, in line with revisions to the Child Welfare Act and other laws, and to update the wording of the ordinance.
